answer_1.quote: We propose a generative model Bi-Phone that is able to synthetically produce spelling corruption in accordance with L1‑L2 confusions (Sections 3.1, 3.2).
answer_1.outputs: Phonetic misspellings (spelling corruptions) of English words

answer_2.quote: We compute the coverage of Bi-Phone in web data by considering the fraction of sentences where the misspelling confidence score is greater than a certain threshold … Figure presents the precision and coverage at different thresholds.

answer_4.quote: For each language, we present 150 randomly selected word, misspelling pairs generated from Bi-Phone to native speakers … Each rater provides a 1 or 0 to indicate whether the variant looks plausible … We also sample a subset of the sentences to have human raters verify that our retrieved misspellings indeed correspond to the original word.
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluate whether a misspelling is plausible for pronunciation shifts (binary 1/0); for web sentences they verify if the correction is valid in context.
